fields.description: SAMANA Resorts offers studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments in Dubai Production City. Its published layouts include private pools, with selected one-bedroom homes adding a store or maid’s room. These ancillary rooms are separate from the bedroom count.

overview: The brochure shows five layout families: studio, one-bedroom, one-bedroom with store, one-bedroom with maid’s room, and two-bedroom, all illustrated with pools.
research.priceNote: The developer headline and structured offer show AED 1,350,882. Its FAQ gives a rounded AED 1.3m reference; obtain a current unit quotation.
research.handoverNote: Developer FAQ: Q3 2028. Property Finder: December 2026. These materially different targets remain unresolved; neither confirms completion.
research.paymentNote: PDC: 15% booking + 42 monthly payments of 1% + 10% in month 12 + 5% in month 18 + 56 monthly payments of 0.5%. Non-PDC starts at 20% and ends with 46 payments of 0.5%. Each totals 100%; confirm the dated contract.
